acceptanceCriteria: A CEM bridge call that exceeds the Git budget returns corpus-capacity-exceeded, not repository-unavailable.
A test fails on the current mapping and passes after the fix.
body: Found by the V1-1984 lane (PR #1253). V1-1984 added doccorpus.Typed so the CLI and the corpus MCP bridge map a Git capacity failure to corpus-capacity-exceeded (DCP-V1-158). The CEM bridge still maps git-budget-exceeded to repository-unavailable, which tells the caller the repository is missing when it is only over a capacity bound. Expected: the CEM bridge uses doccorpus.Typed (or an equivalent) and reports corpus-capacity-exceeded with the limit and count.
title: CEM corpus bridge reports git-budget-exceeded as repository-unavailable instead of corpus-capacity-exceeded
